CONTROLS.NAME: TOGGLE_ON_BEAT
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle this on the beat to set the BPM of the animation

CONTROLS.NAME: bass_rotate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rotates the dispersion direction with the Bass

CONTROLS.NAME: extra_noise
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds an extra fuzz to the dispersion

CONTROLS.NAME: dispersion_contrast
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Contrast applied during the dispersion effect

CONTROLS.NAME: extra_brightness
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds in extra brightness if the scene is too dark

CONTROLS.NAME: bass_twitcher
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds some twitchy motion when the bass hits

CONTROLS.NAME: stroke_thickness
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Thickness of the lines in the shape

CONTROLS.NAME: fuzz_shape
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds more fuzz to the shape

CONTROLS.NAME: fuzz_high_hits
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds audio reactive fuzz to the shape

CONTROLS.NAME: media_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds media color into the scene

CONTROLS.NAME: mask_shape
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Allow the shape to mask the media

CONTROLS.NAME: shape_affect_media
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Allow the shape to affect the media's dispersion

CONTROLS.NAME: media_affect_dispersion
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Allow the media to affect its own dispersion
